Du bliver en central spiller i udviklingen af løsninger, der understøtter og håndterer centrale kundedata på tværs af hele koncernen. Det er software, der bliver brugt hver dag, og som skal fungere hver gang. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke arkitektur, teknologivalg og udviklingsmetoder i tæt samarbejde med både forretningen og de teams, der er afhængige af jeres leverancer.


**Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver**  

Som Senior Software Engineer får du en rolle med både hands\-on udvikling og mulighed for teknisk lederskab:


* Udvikling af services og API’er: Design, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af højkvalitets software i Java afviklet på WebLogic og Kubernetes.
* Cloud platforme: Drive og understøtte ibrugtagning af cloud\-infrastruktur inden for kundedatadomænet.
* Kvalitet og standarder: Sikre høj kodekvalitet gennem bl.a. code reviews, ”Clean Code”\-principper og automatiserede tests som fx Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD), Test\-Driven Development (TDD).
* Performance og sikkerhed: Indtænke performance og sikkerhed i hele udviklingslivscyklussen – fra design til drift.
* Innovation og AI: Tage ejerskab for anvendelsen af AI\-værktøjer i udviklingsarbejdet og bidrage til smartere og mere effektive leverancer.
* Samarbejde på tværs: Arbejde tæt sammen med andre teams i Nykredit, hvor vores løsninger ofte er en kritisk byggesten i større initiativer.

**Er det dig, vi leder efter?**
  

Vi forestiller os, at du:


* Har minimum 5 års erfaring som softwareudvikler og er tryg i rollen som senior.
* Har en relevant uddannelse inden for datalogi, software engineering eller lignende – eller tilsvarende erfaring.
* Arbejder solidt med Java (Java EE / Jakarta EE / Spring Boot) og har erfaring med:
	+ API\-design og microservices
	+ CI/CD, event frameworks, datamodellering og databasemodellering
	+ Værktøjer som fx Atlassian tool suite, \-Maven, \-Github, \-SonarQube og \-Snyk m.fl.
* Anvender AI i dit daglige arbejde (i alle faser af udviklingsarbejdet)
* Har interesse for – og gerne erfaring med – finansielle systemer og komplekse forretningsdomæner.
* Tænker i løsninger, tager ansvar og trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og tæt samarbejde.
* Kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk og har lyst til at dele viden og løfte andre omkring dig.

Kendskab til Quarkus, .NET og Azure er en fordel, men ikke et krav.


Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.


**Dit nye team**
  

Du bliver en del af Core Customer\-teamet i Nykredit Core Banking, som har ansvaret for at levere IT\-løsninger inden for kunde\- og partsdata, herunder relaterede systemer, og som er i gang med en teknologisk transformation mod cloud\-baseret arkitektur.


Teamet er tværfagligt og består af udviklere, QA og forretningsprofiler fordelt mellem København og Warszawa, hvor samarbejde og fælles ejerskab for leverancerne er i fokus.


Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.


**Hvorfor skal du vælge os?**
  

I Nykredits IT\-afdeling bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor teknologi, samarbejde og kontinuerlig læring er centrale drivkræfter. Vi arbejder med komplekse og forretningskritiske løsninger, der har en konkret betydning for den finansielle sektor, og hvor kvalitet, stabilitet og sikkerhed ikke er til forhandling.


Du får mulighed for at arbejde på udfordrende projekter med reel forretningsmæssig værdi, i et miljø præget af faglig sparring, videndeling og fokus på arkitektur og bæredygtige løsninger. Samtidig tilbyder vi konkurrencedygtige vilkår, attraktive personalegoder, mulighed for én hjemmearbejdsdag om ugen og gode muligheder for både faglig og karrieremæssig udvikling i en organisation, der investerer i sine medarbejdere.


Stillingen er placeret på Nykredit\-koncernens hovedkontor i Nordhavn. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet i hverdagen, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge fornuftigt sammen.


**Vil du vide mere?**
  

Du er velkommen til at kontakte mig, Development Manager Jesper Søndergaard på tlf. 22 45 10 41, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. Du kan også finde mig på LinkedIn her: Jesper Søndergaard \| LinkedIn

jobs.description:
**Job i Eksponent**
-------------------


Vi søger en erfaren/senior udvikler til vores kontor i København. Udvikleren vi søger skal arbejde med en bred række opgaver inden for området \- både med arkitektur, DevOps, udvikling og selvfølgelig sparring til kunder og kollegaer.


Du bliver en central brik på en række af vores vigtigste projekter og i vores organisation, hvor du med din erfaring og kompetencer er med til at styrke vores leverancer. Området vi søger indenfor driver nogle af vores største web\-applikationer.


Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med andre dygtige og ambitiøse udviklere. Derudover indgår projektledere, rådgivere, designere og UX\-specialister på vores teams.

### **Hvad leder vi efter?**

* Ca. 5 års fuldtidserfaring inden for softwareudvikling og har opnået en solid forståelse for hele softwareudviklingsprocessen – fra arkitektur og specifikation til udvikling og vedligeholdelse.
* Erfaring med C\#/.NET/Azure økosystemet og glad for postgress.
* Erfaring med web\-applikationer og uforskrækket over at lave mindre React\-opgaver, selvom det ikke er din primære kompetence.
* Nysgerrig over for AI og så meget hands\-on erfaring at du ved, hvad der (ofte) virker. Bruger Claude Code eller Codex eller Pi.dev eller OpenCode eller tilsvarende. Du behøver ikke være totalt AI\-pilled.
* Gode mundtlige og skriftlige kommunikationsevner og kan formidle komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på en forståelig måde til både tekniske og ikke\-tekniske interessenter på dansk.
* Er selvstændig, struktureret og \- meget vigtigt \- nysgerrig på, hvad der sker inden for de nyeste teknologier inden for webudvikling.
* Du synes, at det er sjovt at løse problemer med teknologi generelt \- ikke kun når du får penge for det.
* Hvis du har erfaring fra bureau eller konsulentvirksomhed er det en fordel.
* Et særligt plus, hvis du har erfaring eller domæneviden fra offentlige kunder og sagsbehandlingssystemer.

**Hvad kan du forvente i Eksponent?**
-------------------------------------

* Dygtige kolleger og ambitiøse kunder
* Et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til hjemmearbejde
* Effektive projektforløb, hvor du løbende ser resultatet af dit arbejde
* Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi arbejder tværfagligt og passer på hinanden
* En faglig konto til kurser og læring
* En hardwarekonto og eget valg af computer og telefon
* God kantineordning og masser af sociale events
* Konkurrencedygtig løn med pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, telefon og internet

### **Hvem er vi?**


I Eksponent arbejder vi med digitalisering. Vores mål er at hjælpe kunder med at forbedre kommunikation, samarbejde og services. Vi designer og udvikler ambitiøse digitale produkter \- fra websites til forretningssystemer. Vi rådgiver, faciliterer, og inddrager brugere og kunder. Kulturen er uformel, men professionel. Nysgerrighed, faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd.


Samarbejdet med vores kunder er baseret på et partnerskabs\-mindset, hvor vi gør meget ud af at forstå vores kunders forretning og organisation. Det gør os i stand til at styre og rådgive bedre, og det er forudsætningen for den særlige kundekultur, som Eksponent er kendt for.

### **Vil du vide mere?**


Vil du vide mere om stillingen, og hvordan vi arbejder med softwareudvikling i Eksponent, er du velkommen til at kontakte Martin (martin.bjorn@eksponent.com) eller Christian (christian.dalager@eksponent.com).

### **Søg stillingen**


Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@eksponent.com og skriv “Fullstack udvikler .Net / AI” i emnefeltet. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer – Application Experience
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Build the operational applications that power the future of intelligent manufacturing.  

  

Join Agilent's Global OT \& AI Engineering organization and help develop modern operational applications that transform how work is performed across our global operations.  

  

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will design, develop, and maintain intuitive digital applications that empower operators, engineers, technicians, supervisors, and manufacturing leaders with real\-time access to information, workflows, and intelligent decision support.  

  

Your solutions will extend enterprise capabilities beyond traditional desktop applications by delivering secure, connected, and user\-centric operational experiences across mobile devices, tablets, industrial workstations, and other frontline technologies.  

  

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Data Engineers, AI \& Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will build applications that simplify operational processes, improve workforce productivity, and accelerate Agilent's digital transformation.  

  

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

**About Global OT \& AI Engineering**

  

Global OT \& AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.


Our organization combines software engineering, cloud technologies, Artificial Intelligence, enterprise data platforms, industrial automation, and Smart Factory solutions to create scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision\-making, and enable continuous improvement.


Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.


Our portfolio includes:

* Global Operations Control Tower
* Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
* AI \& Decision Intelligence Platform
* Smart Factory Applications
* Operational Applications
* Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
* Digital Twin Solutions
* Enterprise KPI Platform
* AI\-powered Digital Coworkers

**About the Role**

  

Operational excellence depends on providing the right information to the right people at the right time.


As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Operational Applications, you will develop applications that connect frontline employees with enterprise systems, operational data, and intelligent services. Whether supporting manufacturing execution, quality inspections, maintenance activities, warehouse operations, engineering workflows, or operational approvals, your applications will help simplify work and improve decision\-making across Agilent's manufacturing network.


You'll work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to build secure, scalable, and intuitive operational applications that integrate seamlessly with enterprise platforms, AI capabilities, and Smart Factory technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **Operational Application Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain modern operational applications that support manufacturing, quality, supply chain, engineering, warehouse, logistics, and operational workflows.
* Build intuitive applications that improve productivity, simplify frontline activities, and enhance user experience.
* Develop reusable application components that accelerate delivery across multiple operational solutions.
* Ensure applications are responsive, secure, accessible, and optimized for operational environments.

**Workforce Productivity Solutions**

* Develop digital work instructions, operational checklists, inspection applications, maintenance workflows, inventory transactions, approvals, and task management solutions.
* Deliver intuitive user experiences that reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
* Support offline capabilities and reliable synchronization where network connectivity may be limited.
* Design solutions that enable users to complete operational tasks efficiently across various devices.

**Enterprise Integration**

* Integrate operational applications with enterprise platforms including SAP, MES, enterprise data platforms, AI services, and backend APIs.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers to consume secure enterprise services.
* Work with Data Engineers to deliver trusted operational information.
* Embed AI\-powered capabilities such as intelligent recommendations, conversational assistants, and contextual insights into operational workflows.

**User Experience \& Adoption**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and user needs.
* Design simple, intuitive workflows that improve adoption and reduce training effort.
* Continuously enhance application usability through user feedback and iterative improvements.
* Promote consistent user experience across operational applications.

**Innovation \& Emerging Technologies**

* Evaluate emerging technologies that improve operational productivity, including enterprise mobility, wearable devices, barcode and QR technologies, camera integration, voice interaction, and AI\-assisted user experiences.
* Prototype innovative digital capabilities that enhance frontline operations and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to Agilent's long\-term Operational Applications strategy by identifying opportunities to simplify work through technology.

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence teams to understand operational requirements and deliver practical digital solutions.
* Collaborate closely with Application Experience Engineers, Platform Engineers, Smart Factory Engineers, Data Engineers, and AI specialists to develop integrated enterprise applications.
* Participate in Agile development, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Technology Environment**

  

You'll have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

**Application Development**

* Flutter
* React Native
* .NET MAUI
* React
* TypeScript

 **Programming**

* Dart
* JavaScript
* C\#

 **Enterprise Integration**

* REST APIs
* GraphQL (preferred)
* SignalR

 **Cloud Platforms**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS

 **Device Capabilities**

* Barcode \& QR Code
* Camera Integration
* NFC
* Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)
* Push Notifications
* Offline Data Synchronization

 **Enterprise Platforms**

* SAP ERP
* SAP ME / MES
* Enterprise Data Platform
* AI Services
* Global Operations Control Tower

 **DevOps**

* GitHub
* Azure DevOps
* CI/CD Pipelines

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required Qualifications**


We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.


You should have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mobile Computing, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing enterprise applications using modern web, mobile, or cross\-platform technologies.
* Understanding of RESTful APIs and enterprise application integration.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Passion for building digital solutions that improve operational efficiency and user productivity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

* Flutter, React Native, .NET MAUI, or other cross\-platform development frameworks.
* Enterprise mobility and offline\-first application development.
* User\-centered design and operational workflow optimization.
* Manufacturing, warehouse, supply chain, or industrial applications.
* AI\-enabled user experiences and intelligent assistants.
* Cloud\-native application development.
* Industry 4\.0, Smart Manufacturing, or Connected Worker technologies.

**Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. With the rapid development of Industry 4\.0, UMC Singapore is transforming from a traditional semiconductor manufacturing factory to a brand\-new enterprise of intelligent and smart manufacturing. A fully automatic transmission in our large manufacturing base with thousands of process data recorded per minute and hundreds of millions of equipment parameters collected per second. Imagine the most advanced intelligent and intelligent manufacturing applications such as APC, VM, PHM/RPA requires your talents to tap the value in these data to ensure the leading quality of our products and enable engineers to handle the tedious work easily.
  
  

UMC ESI is looking for talents in data analysis and processing, data visualization, algorithm, big data and artificial intelligence system development. Join us and start a new chapter in your career!
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Day to Day on equipment parameter FDC daily index and to timely address on abnormalities
  
  

Be familiar with communication protocols to obtain real\-time equipment data as equipment monitoring parameters
  
  

Perform data collection, collation and analysis to find productivity, yield, cost and other opportunities for improvement
  
  

Use various data algorithms and tools to process large amounts of data (visualize and set control to the data)
  
  

Coordinate PC/PHM/Virtual metrology/RPA and other smart manufacturing project development and management
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Possess at least a bachelor's degree in engineering
  
  

Able to think critically and possess research skills
  
  

Possess good communication skills
  
  

Possess good time management skills as well as a strong sense of commitment
  
  

Proficiency in C\#, .NET, Python, R, SQL and other similar languages ​​or tools
  
  

Prior leadership or competition experience (preferably in artificial intelligence projects) will be an advantage
  
  

Candidates with at least 2 years of relevant prior working experience may be considered for a senior position
  
  

UMC is a leading global semiconductor foundry company. The company provides high quality IC fabrication services, focusing on logic and various specialty technologies to serve all major sectors of the electronics industry. UMC’s comprehensive IC processing technologies and manufacturing solutions include Logic/Mixed\-Signal, embedded High\-Voltage, embedded Non\-Volatile\-Memory, RFSOI and BCD etc. Most of UMC's 12\-in \& 8\-in fabs with its core R\&D are located in Taiwan, with additional ones throughout Asia. UMC has total 12 fabs in production with combined capacity close to 800,000 wafers per month (8\-in equivalent), and all of them are certified with IATF\-16949 automotive quality standard.
  
  

UMC is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, plus local offices in United States, Europe, China, Japan, Korea and Singapore, with worldwide total 20,000 employees.

jobs.description:
Job Overview
  
  

With the rapid development of Industry 4\.0, UMC Singapore is transforming from a traditional semiconductor manufacturing factory to a brand\-new enterprise of intelligent and smart manufacturing. A fully automatic transmission in our large manufacturing base with thousands of process data recorded per minute and hundreds of millions of equipment parameters collected per second. Imagine the most advanced intelligent and intelligent manufacturing applications such as APC, VM, PHM/RPA requires your talents to tap the value in these data to ensure the leading quality of our products and enable engineers to handle the tedious work easily.
  
  

UMC ESI is looking for talents in data analysis and processing, data visualization, algorithm, big data and artificial intelligence system development. Join us and start a new chapter in your career!
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Day to Day on equipment parameter FDC daily index and to timely address on abnormalities
  
  

Be familiar with communication protocols to obtain real\-time equipment data as equipment monitoring parameters
  
  

Perform data collection, collation and analysis to find productivity, yield, cost and other opportunities for improvement
  
  

Use various data algorithms and tools to process large amounts of data (visualize and set control to the data)
  
  

Coordinate PC/PHM/Virtual metrology/RPA and other smart manufacturing project development and management
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Possess at least a bachelor's degree in engineering
  
  

Able to think critically and possess research skills
  
  

Possess good communication skills
  
  

Possess good time management skills as well as a strong sense of commitment
  
  

Proficiency in C\#, .NET, Python, R, SQL and other similar languages ​​or tools
  
  

Prior leadership or competition experience (preferably in artificial intelligence projects) will be an advantage
  
  

Candidates with at least 2 years of relevant prior working experience may be considered for a senior position
  
  

UMC is a leading global semiconductor foundry company. The company provides high quality IC fabrication services, focusing on logic and various specialty technologies to serve all major sectors of the electronics industry. UMC’s comprehensive IC processing technologies and manufacturing solutions include Logic/Mixed\-Signal, embedded High\-Voltage, embedded Non\-Volatile\-Memory, RFSOI and BCD etc. Most of UMC's 12\-in \& 8\-in fabs with its core R\&D are located in Taiwan, with additional ones throughout Asia. UMC has total 12 fabs in production with combined capacity close to 800,000 wafers per month (8\-in equivalent), and all of them are certified with IATF\-16949 automotive quality standard.
  
  

UMC is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, plus local offices in United States, Europe, China, Japan, Korea and Singapore, with worldwide total 20,000 employees.

jobs.title: AI Application Engineer - (Public Sector)
jobs.description:
At Xtremax, we are looking for an **AI Application Engineer** to help turn promising AI prototypes into secure, production\-ready applications. You will work on AI\-enabled solutions such as chatbots, RAG applications, workflow assistants, agents, automation tools, and AI\-powered business applications.


You will work across the full application lifecycle, from understanding business outcomes and assessing early prototypes to engineering, testing, deployment, observability, and production support. The role combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical AI application development, giving you the opportunity to work with technologies including **Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java, and modern CI/CD platforms**.


This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of experimentation and production. You will help establish reusable engineering patterns for AI applications while ensuring that security, privacy, responsible AI, observability, cost management, and long\-term supportability are built into solutions from the start.


Responsibility* Refactor prototypes and AI\-assisted applications into secure, maintainable, production\-grade solutions with clean architecture, robust APIs, authentication, and automated deployment pipelines.
* Design, build, and harden AI\-enabled applications including chatbots, RAG solutions, workflow assistants, agents, automation tools, and AI\-assisted business applications.
* Work with product owners and business stakeholders to translate use cases into clear user journeys, measurable outcomes, adoption metrics, and production\-readiness requirements.
* Develop full\-stack application capabilities across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, data integrations, authentication, authorization, logging, and monitoring.
* Integrate applications with approved AI and enterprise services such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Microsoft Graph, and enterprise APIs.
* Apply secure and responsible AI patterns including prompt management, retrieval grounding, input/output controls, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, auditability, and content safety controls.
* Develop reusable AI application patterns, starter templates, and engineering playbooks to accelerate delivery across different use cases.
* Build automated testing for AI applications, including functional and regression testing, prompt evaluation, response quality checks, and guardrail validation.
* Implement application and AI observability covering logs, model usage, latency, token consumption, errors, user feedback, cost, and key business metrics.
* Collaborate with platform engineering teams on cloud deployment, CI/CD, containerisation, API management, secrets management, monitoring, production support, and operational handover.

  

**Requirements**  

* 7\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, including experience building, deploying, and supporting enterprise or cloud\-native applications.
* Strong full\-stack engineering capability using modern frontend, backend, and API technologies such as **React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, .NET, Java**, or equivalent.
* Hands\-on experience designing and integrating **REST APIs, backend services, databases, authentication mechanisms, and enterprise application integrations**.
* Practical experience building AI\-enabled applications using **large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, agents, workflow automation, or AI orchestration frameworks**.
* Working knowledge of Azure services including **Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, API Management, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics**.
* Experience applying secure software development practices including input validation, secrets management, least\-privilege access, dependency scanning, logging, error handling, and secure configuration.
* Understanding of authentication and authorisation standards including **OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JWT, RBAC**, and enterprise identity integration using **Microsoft Entra ID**.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using **Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitHub Actions, ShipHATS**, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with containerisation, cloud deployment patterns, environment promotion, deployment rollback, and production support practices.
* Ability to assess prototype quality and identify what needs to be rebuilt, hardened, monitored, or redesigned before production release.
* Good understanding of AI application risks including hallucination, data leakage, prompt injection, unsafe tool use, policy bypass, privacy risks, and poor explainability.
* Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and production trade\-offs clearly.
* Comfortable working in an agile, product\-oriented environment where solutions are delivered iteratively and improved through user feedback and engineering practices.

**Nice to Haves**

* Experience building chatbots, knowledge assistants, workflow agents, document intelligence solutions, recommendation assistants, or AI\-enabled internal tools.
* Experience with AI application frameworks such as **LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI**, or equivalent orchestration tools.
* Experience with vector databases or search technologies such as **Azure AI Search, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Cosmos DB, Pinecone**, or similar platforms.
* Experience with AI evaluation, prompt testing, red teaming, safety evaluations, grounding quality checks, or responsible AI controls.
* Experience integrating with **Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform**, or enterprise workflow systems.
* Familiarity with public sector cloud environments, government security requirements, data classification, privacy, and compliance obligations.
* Exposure to observability, SRE practices, incident response, service health dashboards, and production support models.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise**, or equivalent tools to improve engineering productivity, testing, and documentation.

  

**Benefits**  

By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment.


You also represent to us that you have obtained the consent of your referees when you disclose to us their personal data for the purpose of conducting reference checks.


The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here:


We regret to inform you that should you not consent to providing the necessary data required for us to process your application, your application will be considered void.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI\-driven data economy.


As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.


We combine deep engineering expertise with global\-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.


This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.


We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.


Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

 **Job Description** **About This Role — The Mission**


You will be one of the engineers on a focused AI team solving hard scientific problems in precision product development. You will own two real responsibilities from day one — not toy tasks, but actual team workflow contributions that senior engineers depend on. You will be introduced to physics\-informed AI, Bayesian methods, and product development ML systems within your first year under direct mentorship from engineers and researchers who have worked at world\-class institutions. If you are the kind of person who learns fast and wants to be in the middle of hard problems early in your career, this is an unusual opportunity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Experiment Tracking \& Evaluation Reporting:** Own MLflow experiment logging for assigned team model runs; conduct model evaluations using standard metrics; produce structured evaluation reports reviewed by team. Your reports directly inform model iteration decisions.
* **Training Data Quality Validation:** Validate training datasets jointly with team — feature distribution checks, label verification, anomaly flagging. Your quality flags are the final check before data enters the model training pipeline. You close the data quality loop between workstreams.
* **Deep Learning Model Contribution:** Build and train CNN\-based models for image classification and defect detection under team’s guidance. Contribute to model evaluation cycles, configuration comparisons, and training run analysis.
* **ML Pipeline Contribution:** Package models in Docker; contribute to CI/CD scripts under guidance; run inference tests and support deployment validation in product development environments.

  

**Qualifications** **Requirements**


Education:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field. AI major or strong research focus in degree strongly preferred.


Experience:

* Fresh graduate to 1 year. Work experience not required — demonstrated ML project competency is the primary criterion. Strong final\-year project or thesis with a clear ML component; research internship preferred.


Must Have Skill:

* Python: Strong proficiency — clean, readable ML code; NumPy/Pandas basics
* PyTorch: Foundational — build, train, and evaluate a basic neural network independently from scratch
* CNN Architecture Basics: Understand and implement a basic image classifier; conceptual understanding of convolutional layers
* Surrogate Modeling Concepts: Why data\-efficient ML matters in limited\-data scientific settings
* Active Learning Awareness: Conceptual understanding of uncertainty\-guided data selection
* MLflow Basics: Log experiments, parameters, and metrics for a training run
* Docker Basics: Write a Dockerfile to containerize a Python/ML application
* Model Evaluation: Standard metrics; produce a structured evaluation report
* Learning Mindset: Self\-directed learning outside coursework; evidence of picking up new concepts quickly.


Good\-to\-Have Skill:

* U\-Net or ViT exposure — academic project or course sufficient
* Uncertainty quantification basics — Monte Carlo dropout, ensemble methods
* Bayesian methods introduction — any probabilistic ML course or project
* Time\-series or sensor data — any project with sequential or temporal data
* RL introduction — any RL course or gym environment experiment
* RAG basics, any LLM project
* AWS fundamentals; entry\-level cloud ML deployment

You will report to the Director, Cybersecurity AI Product and work as part of a newly formed product development team focused on building and operating agentic solutions that help users investigate threats, triage alerts, automate security workflows, analyze vulnerabilities, and make better security decisions.

jobs.title: Ant International-FI Partnership & Platform Solutions-Bettr Platform Tech SG
jobs.description:
**Job description**
  

  

We are looking for a senior FI Partnership professional who can operate at the intersection of relationship management, business development, and solution architecture. You will be the primary face to global banks, asset managers, and other financial institutions (FIs), responsible for not only owning the relationship with the Fis but also both selling Ant International's platform technology products and architecting the solutions that embed them into our partners' operations.
  

  

Your work will directly advance Ant International's payment rails across multiple business pillars, while also driving our tokenization and digital asset strategy with institutional partners.
  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

  

1\. FI Partnership \& Strategic Sales
  

  

* Own and deepen relationships with tier\-1 banks, asset managers, and other FIs in your region / coverage.

  

* Drive the full sales cycle: identify prospects, pitch platform solutions, negotiate commercials, and close partnerships.

  

* Meet revenue and partnership targets for Platform Tech internal products (payments, settlement, treasury, FX, and tokenization infrastructure).

  

* Conduct regular business reviews with FI partners; monitor onboarding and ensure service excellence.

  

2\. Solution Architecture \& RFPs
  

  

* Translate client business needs into technical solution designs using Ant's platform capabilities (AI, blockchain, tokenization, and core payment rails).

  

* Lead RFP/RFI responses and solution proposals on FX, settlement, fund management, and cross\-border payment products.

  

* Configure system parameters, integration workflows, and product architectures tailored to each FI partner.

  

* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to scope requirements, define SLAs, and ensure seamless delivery.

  

3\. Market \& Product Strategy
  

  

* Research local market infrastructure, regulatory frameworks, and compliance policies for overseas fund management and treasury operations.

  

* Identify opportunities to expand payment rails and tokenization use cases with FIs.

  

* Stay ahead of emerging trends in digital assets, blockchain settlement, and AI\-driven financial infrastructure.

  

* Feed market intelligence back to product teams to shape the roadmap.

  

4\. Risk \& Project Management
  

  

* Manage end\-to\-end project delivery with FIs \- from concept and contracting to go\-live and optimization.

  

* Establish risk diversification mechanisms and counterparty governance across partner institutions.

  

* Ensure all solutions meet security, scalability, and compliance standards.

  

**Job Requirement**
  

  

* \>10 years of experience in FI partnership, business development, solution architecture, or pre\-sales within banks, card schemes, large international payment companies, or fintech platforms.

  

* Proven sales track record: demonstrated ability to sell complex B2B technology or financial infrastructure products to banks and FIs.

  

* Solution architecture mindset: comfortable designing technical solutions, leading RFPs, and bridging business needs with engineering execution.

  

* Deep knowledge of global bank settlement, FX products, cross\-border payments, and treasury management; tokenization or digital asset experience is a strong plus.

  

* Familiarity with the operational and business models of cross\-border fund settlement and clearing.

  

* Strong understanding of overseas payment regulations and cross\-border fund compliance policies.

  

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; able to influence C\-suite and technical audiences alike.

  

* Leadership presence with experience running large, cross\-functional projects under pressure.

  

* Willingness to travel extensively (up to 25\-30%) for client meetings, workshops, and implementation support.

  

Good\-to\-Have
  

  

* Experience with blockchain, tokenization platforms, or digital asset custody infrastructure.

  

* Prior work in fund management, asset servicing, or FX prime brokerage.

  

* Regional language skills aligned to key markets.

  

What Success Looks Like
  

  

* You close net\-new FI partnerships that expand Ant International's payment rail coverage.

  

* You architect solutions that become reference\-able wins for Platform Tech products.

  

* You build trusted advisor status with CIOs, Heads of Digital, and Treasury leaders at major global banks.

jobs.title: RVP, Solutions Engineering APAC
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Location:Singapore**

**Reports To: SVP, Global Presales**

Zendesk is looking for a visionary, highly technical, and dynamic **Regional Vice President of Sales Engineering** to lead, scale, and inspire our world\-class team of Sales Engineers. Zendesk has evolved far beyond traditional ITSM and help desk ticketing; we are the world’s leading **AI\-powered Customer Experience (CX) platform** .


In this role, you will bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI capabilities and enterprise business value. As a key partner to regional sales leadership, you will drive our expansion into net\-new enterprise markets, optimize technical win rates, and ensure our customers accelerate their time\-to\-value. You must be a technical heavyweight, an inspiring leader of leaders, and a compelling public speaker capable of evangelizing the future of AI\-driven CX to C\-suite executives.


### **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* **Strategic Market Expansion:** Partner with Regional RVPs of Sales to penetrate new enterprise markets and verticals. Architect the pre\-sales blueprint required to land complex, large\-scale enterprise accounts.
* **Drive Technical Win \& Adoption Rates:** Establish rigorous pre\-sales frameworks, proof\-of\-concept (PoC) and pilot standards, and custom demo strategies that directly improve technical win rates and lay the foundation for rapid post\-sale user adoption.
* **Team Development \& Leadership:** Attract, hire, and retain top\-tier pre\-sales talent. Cultivate a high\-performance culture focused on technical excellence and consultative value selling. Mentor front\-line SE managers to become impactful leaders.
* **AI \& CX Thought Leadership:** Serve as a primary technical evangelist for the region. Deliver compelling keynotes at industry events, lead executive briefings, and command authority during large\-scale enterprise pitches by articulating Zendesk’s advanced AI and platform capabilities.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Act as a critical feedback loop between the field, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure our AI CX roadmap continues to solve the most pressing challenges of the world's largest enterprises.

### **Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical field is **required** . An advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* **Management Experience:** 8\+ years of experience managing pre\-sales/sales engineering teams, with at least 3\+ years of experience managing people\-managers (leading a multi\-tiered organization) within a fast\-growing, enterprise SaaS environment.
* **CX Domain Expertise:** Deep familiarity with the broader **Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem** , including CRM, contact center technology (CCaaS), workforce engagement management (WEM), and digital engagement channels.
* **Advanced Technical Acumen:** Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS), data privacy/security compliance, complex integrations (REST APIs, webhooks), and a strong foundational grasp of **Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and machine learning applications** in CX.
* **Public Speaking \& Executive Presence:** Documented history of public speaking, presenting at major industry conferences, or facilitating high\-stakes C\-suite workshops. Exceptional ability to translate dense technical concepts into business outcomes.
* **Commercial Mindset:** Proven track record of successfully partnering with enterprise sales teams to capture market share, increase Average Contract Value (ACV), and accelerate sales velocity.

### **Why Join Zendesk?**

At Zendesk, we are entirely focused on liberating companies from legacy, fragmented systems by providing an intelligent, unified AI CX platform. As an RVP of Sales Engineering, you will have the autonomy to shape our go\-to\-market technical strategy, lead an elite team of engineers, and directly influence how the world’s biggest brands design their customer experiences.


**The intelligent heart of customer experience**

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.


Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.


As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.


Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, \& inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here .


Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e\-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

jobs.description:
The Green Building \& Energy /Solar Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing solar energy systems and other renewable energy solutions. This role involves conducting technical assessments, preparing feasibility studies, managing installation projects, and ensuring compliance with sustainability standards and regulations. The engineer will also provide expertise on energy efficiency initiatives, performance monitoring, and cost optimization.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**System Design \& Engineering:** Design solar PV systems (rooftop, ground\-mounted, hybrid, off\-grid, on\-grid) including electrical, structural, and mechanical components. Perform energy yield simulations and financial analysis using tools such as PVsyst, Helioscope, or HOMER. Develop system layouts, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.
  
  

**Feasibility \& Site Assessment:** Conduct site visits, shading analysis, and structural evaluations. Assess solar potential, energy consumption patterns, and load profiles. Prepare feasibility reports and ROI projections.
  
  

**Project Execution \& Management:** Support procurement of solar modules, inverters, batteries, and balance\-of\-system equipment. Coordinate with EPC contractors, vendors, and stakeholders during installation. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with safety standards.
  
  

**Operations \& Maintenance:** Monitor system performance and troubleshoot technical issues. Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance for solar systems. Recommend improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability.
  
  

**Energy Efficiency \& Sustainability:** Identify and implement energy\-saving measures across facilities. Support net\-zero, carbon reduction, and ESG initiatives. Provide technical input for sustainability reporting and certification programs.
  
  

Job Requirements
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  
  

2\-5 years of experience in solar PV design, installation, or energy engineering.
  
  

Proficiency with solar design software (PVsyst, AutoCAD, Helioscope, HOMER, etc.).
  
  

Strong knowledge of electrical codes, grid connection requirements, and safety standards.

Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills.

jobs.description:
**DevTeix** est une société dynamique d'une dizaine de personnes qui développe, depuis plus de 30 ans, des logiciels sur mesure pour l'industrie. Elle commercialise notamment des logiciels de gestion de production (GPAO) destinés aux usines de charpentes métalliques et de bois lamellé\-collé : Steel Manager et Wood Manager. Les bureaux de DevTeix sont situés dans le zoning industriel des Hauts\-Sarts, à Herstal.

**Wood Manager**, l'application la plus récente de DevTeix, est développée entièrement en C\# et utilisée quotidiennement en atelier pour piloter la production de poutres en bois lamellé\-collé, depuis la réception des pièces jusqu'à leur mise en presse pour le collage. Une étape centrale de cette production est le plan de serrage : une fenêtre dans laquelle l'opérateur dispose, oriente et ajuste les poutres qui seront collées ensemble, via une visionneuse 3D (Eyeshot).

Cette fenêtre propose de nombreuses actions qui, une fois effectuées, sont directement enregistrées en base de données. Le revers de cet enregistrement immédiat : il n'existe aujourd'hui aucun moyen de revenir en arrière, et la moindre erreur de manipulation oblige l'opérateur à corriger la situation manuellement.

Votre mission sera de développer un véritable système d'annulation et de rétablissement (Ctrl\+Z / Ctrl\+Y) pour cette fenêtre. Cela demande de bien comprendre le fonctionnement actuel du plan de serrage et l'ensemble de ses actions, puis de concevoir une structure (par exemple basée sur le patron de conception Command) capable, pour chaque type d'action, de mémoriser les informations nécessaires pour la rejouer ou l'inverser, et d'intégrer cette structure aux traitements existants. Certains cas demanderont une attention particulière, comme les opérations qui génèrent de nouvelles poutres en base (délignage, reprise, aboutage), à annuler proprement sans laisser de données orphelines. Vous réfléchirez aussi à la présentation de cette fonctionnalité à l'utilisateur : raccourcis clavier, boutons, retours visuels clairs.

**Stack technique :** C\#, DevExpress, Eyeshot, SQL Server, EF Core. Aucune connaissance préalable de ces outils n'est requise. La connaissance d'un langage orienté objet (C\#, Java, C\+\+...) ainsi que quelques notions de bases de données sont un plus.

Le stage se déroule en partie sur site à Herstal et en partie à distance (une connexion internet à domicile est nécessaire). Matériel et licences sont fournis par DevTeix. Durée minimale de 3 mois, prolongeable à la demande de l'étudiant, avec un début flexible. Vous serez encadré par un responsable de projet et un développeur DevTeix, et un référent académique est le bienvenu.

Pour candidater, contactez José Teixeira, Executive Director, par mail à j.teixeira@vvtw.be ou par téléphone au \+32 487 41 91 20\.

Avantages :

* Ordinateur de fonction
* Travail à domicile

Lieu du poste : En présentiel

* Elaboración y mantenimiento de inventarios, mapas de dependencias y diagramas de arquitectura.
* Coordinación con equipos técnicos y responsables del cliente para garantizar la estabilidad y evolución del parque aplicativo.
  

  

### **Requisitos técnicos**


**Experiencia en producción**


* Experiencia real gestionando aplicaciones y entornos productivos.
* Despliegue, configuración, diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias.
* Capacidad para analizar problemas de rendimiento, estabilidad y disponibilidad.
  

  

**Observabilidad**


Experiencia implantando soluciones de observabilidad, no únicamente utilizándolas:


* OpenTelemetry
* Application Insights
* Grafana
* Prometheus
* Elastic
* Datadog
* Dynatrace
  

  

Experiencia trabajando con **métricas, logs, trazas, dashboards y sistemas de alertado**.


**Seguridad / DevSecOps**


* Gestión de vulnerabilidades como proceso: detección, triaje, priorización, remediación y seguimiento.
* SAST / DAST / SCA.
* SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, Snyk u otras herramientas equivalentes.
* Gestión de CVEs y vulnerabilidades de dependencias.
* Conocimientos de OWASP aplicado a entornos .NET.
* Hardening y seguridad de aplicaciones.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect y JWT.
  

  

**CI/CD y Releases**


* Experiencia construyendo o gobernando pipelines, no únicamente ejecutándolos.
* Azure DevOps y/o GitHub Actions.
* Quality gates.
* Políticas de Pull Request.
* Automatización y control del proceso de despliegue.
  

  

**.NET**


* Experiencia sólida con C\#.
* Capacidad para leer, diagnosticar y modificar código desarrollado por otros equipos.
* Experiencia trabajando con aplicaciones .NET modernas y/o .NET Framework legacy.
* Experiencia en actualización y migración de versiones.
* SQL Server a nivel de diagnóstico y análisis de problemas.
  

  

**Arquitectura y documentación**


* Inventario de aplicaciones y componentes.
* Mapa de dependencias entre aplicaciones.
* Diagramas de arquitectura.
* Documentación técnica de infraestructura y aplicaciones.
  

  

### **Qué buscamos especialmente**


Buscamos una persona que pueda demostrar que **ha sido responsable de mantener y mejorar aplicaciones que estaban realmente en producción**.


Será especialmente valorable haber trabajado como:


* DevSecOps Engineer con experiencia .NET.
* Application Engineer / Application Support Engineer.
* Software Architect .NET con responsabilidad operativa.
* Application Architect.
* SRE / Reliability Engineer con background .NET.
* Technical Lead con responsabilidad sobre producción.
* Ingeniero de aplicaciones con experiencia en arquitectura y operaciones.
  

  

**No buscamos únicamente un Senior .NET Developer** que haya colaborado puntualmente con equipos de infraestructura, seguridad o DevOps.

  

  

### **Ubicación**


**Madrid o Palma de Mallorca.**


Modelo híbrido con presencia en oficina **2\-3 días por semana**.


Es importante confirmar esta disponibilidad con el candidato **antes de presentar su candidatura**.

  

  

### **Inglés**


No es un requisito bloqueante.

  

  

### **Salario**


A valorar en función de la experiencia y conocimientos técnicos aportados.

**Job Description**
-------------------


Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible.


Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


We are looking for a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer** with proven experience in the design, development, and integration of Artificial Intelligence\-driven solutions, automation, and enterprise applications. The successful candidate will contribute to digital transformation initiatives where AI solutions are integrated with corporate systems, cloud platforms, and business processes, ensuring scalability, security, and operational excellence in production environments.
Your role:
  

* Design and develop **Generative AI** and business automation solutions.
* Integrate AI services with enterprise platforms through APIs and cloud services.
* Participate in the development of backend and frontend applications supporting intelligent solutions.
* Implement conversational agents, virtual assistants, and automated business workflows.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, data, and operations.
* Ensure the industrialization, monitoring, and maintenance of deployed solutions.
* Contribute to architecture design, technical standards, and development best practices.
Your profile:


* 5\+ years of experience in software development.
* Strong experience with **Python** and backend service development.
* Hands\-on experience integrating **AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI** solutions into business processes.
* Experience working with APIs, distributed architectures, and cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of **Azure, AWS**, or equivalent cloud environments.
* Fluent English (C1 level).

#### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365**.
* Knowledge of **.NET, React**, or modern web technologies.
* Experience with **LLMs, NLP, embeddings, RAG, AI agents**, or orchestration frameworks.
* Familiarity with **ServiceNow, ITSM platforms**, or operations automation.
* Experience with **Docker, microservices, and CI/CD** practices.

We value all applications and offer in\-person and online training and certifications. Even if you do not adjust 100% of the requirements, we want to meet you!


**What will you love about working here?**
------------------------------------------


* **Wellbeing HUB** – A full program designed to support your physical and mental wellbeing, including initiatives such as *Wellhub*.
* **Flexible Compensation Plan** – Choose benefits that best fit your needs: medical insurance, transportation, training, meal card or meal allowance, childcare vouchers, and more.
* **Continuous Learning** – Access to *Mylearning*, *Capgemini University*, Digital Campuses, and our Professional Communities. You’ll also have learning platforms like **Coursera, Udemy, Pluralsight, Harvard Manager Mentor**, and **Education First** for language training (English, French, German…), among others!
* **Volunteer \& Social Impact Programs** – Get involved through our Sustainability, Inclusion, and Equality Groups.
* **Buddy Program** – Receive personalized support to help you settle in during your first months.
* **Life \& Accident Insurance** – Additional protection and peace of mind.
**Why Capgemini? Our commitments and priorities:**
--------------------------------------------------


*Our Equality Plan and Code of Ethics ensure inclusive, non\-discriminatory processes that foster talent in a multicultural environment accessible to people with disabilities (we positively value having a disability certificate).*


*Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.*

new_jobs.title: Asset performance engineer
new_jobs.description:
* Den Bosch
* € 4\.223,\- en € 6\.033,\-
* WO
* 32 tot 40 uur


  
* ### **Wat ga je doen?**

#### **Met jouw energie kan het**


	+ Je vertaalt analyses en risico’s naar concrete investerings\- en vervangingsbesluiten.
	+ Je ontwikkelt je tot expert in het vakgebied en levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan de langetermijninstandhouding van onze assets.
	+ Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een flexibel persoonlijk budget, thuiswerkmogelijkheden en een vitaliteitsbudget.
Als assetmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en de vervangingsprojecten van de primaire assets binnen onze hoogspannings\- en middenspanningsstations. Je werkt onder andere aan transformatoren en middenspanningsinstallaties. Door storingen te onderzoeken en trends te analyseren, richt je het onderhoud zo efficiënt mogelijk in. Ook zorg je ervoor dat assets op tijd worden vervangen. Waar mogelijk sluit je deze vervangingen aan op netuitbreidingsplannen. Zo help je de energietransitie vooruit.

#### **Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan**


Binnen Enexis neemt de druk op de instandhouding van onze assets toe. De energietransitie vraagt namelijk niet alleen om uitbreiding van het netwerk, maar ook om een optimale beschikbaarheid van bestaande installaties. Jij zorgt voor een goede balans tussen risico’s, kosten en prestaties. Je maakt onderbouwde keuzes over onderhoud en vervanging en houdt daarbij rekening met de lange termijn. Ook werk je mee aan netuitbreidingsplannen, zodat nieuwe duurzame energie zo snel en betrouwbaar mogelijk kan worden aangesloten.


Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden


	+ Je stelt op risico gebaseerde investeringsvoorstellen en opdrachten op voor vervangingsprojecten.
	+ Je bent budgethouder en hebt beslissingsbevoegdheid voor een geografisch gebied.
	+ Je ontwikkelt je tot expert binnen jouw vakgebied en bent aanspreekpunt voor complexe vraagstukken over de instandhouding van assets.
	+ Je werkt mee aan beleid, onderhoudsdossiers en werkinstructies.
	+ Je vertaalt beleid en werkinstructies naar vragenlijsten voor collega’s die het onderhoud uitvoeren.
* ### **Functie\-eisen**

#### **Zo pak jij het aan**


Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en durft beslissingen te nemen, ook wanneer belangen of risico’s tegen elkaar afgewogen moeten worden. Je werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor kwaliteit en veiligheid. Daarnaast ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement: je weet verschillende partijen met elkaar te verbinden en complexe onderwerpen helder uit te leggen. Met jouw oordeelsvermogen kom je tot onderbouwde keuzes die bijdragen aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige netten.


Verder heb je:


	+ Een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in de richting van elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
	+ Relevante ervaring met onderhoud, assetmanagement of de instandhouding van technische installaties.
	+ Ervaring met beleid schrijven en uitwerken naar werkinstructies
* ### **Team \& cultuur**

#### **Je zet je schouders eronder met**


Jouw collega’s van het cluster Asset Performance Engineering, onderdeel van de afdeling Asset Performance Management. Deze afdeling werkt aan het behouden van het energienet door beleid te ontwikkelen voor onderhoud en vervanging op asset\- en componentniveau. Zo zorgen jullie samen voor de veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid van de energievoorziening.


Binnen de afdeling werken collega’s aan onder andere onderhouds\- en vervangingsbeleid, standaardisatie van componenten, Europese aanbestedingen, marktverkenningen en de implementatie van nieuwe componenten. Ook worden investeringsvoorstellen opgesteld, onderhoud en vervangingen gepland en supply chain management geoptimaliseerd. Transparantie, langetermijnoptimalisatie en het vergroten van de productiecapaciteit staan daarbij centraal.


Je werkt in een omgeving waarin inhoudelijke expertise, samenwerking en continu verbeteren belangrijk zijn. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen tot specialist in asset performance en instandhouding.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.
* ### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

#### **En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou**


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en \-programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:


	+ Salaris tussen € 4\.223,\- en € 6\.033,\- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).
	+ Inclusief de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 7\.764,\- bruto per maand. Je ontvangt namelijk 28,7% bovenop je salaris (8% vakantiegeld, een 13e maand van 10,7% en een persoonlijk budget van 10%). Dit kun je laten uitbetalen wanneer je wilt, of je kunt hier extra verlofdagen van kopen.
	+ 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Meer oplaadtijd nodig? Met je persoonlijke budget en 13e maand kun je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen per jaar kopen.
	+ Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 netto per dag.
	+ Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen: Enexis betaalt twee derde van de premie, jij draagt een derde bij.
	+ Een vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,\- bruto per jaar, dat je bijvoorbeeld kunt inzetten voor je sportabonnement, je hobby of om je huis te verduurzamen. Je kunt dit ook opsparen tot € 2\.100,\- voor je studiekosten of de aflossing van je studieschuld.
	+ Ruimte om te groeien met ons interne ontwikkelplatform en/of externe opleidingen en trainingen. Of je nu wilt doorgroeien, een carrièreswitch overweegt of je skills verder wilt ontwikkelen: wij stimuleren je om het beste uit jezelf te halen.
	+ Laptop of tablet en telefoon die je ook buiten werktijd mag gebruiken.
	+ Een mobiliteitskaart waarmee je eerste klas reist en een reiskostenvergoeding.  

Lees meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.


Werk als assetmanager aan het energienetwerk van morgen

new_jobs.title: senior fullstack developer
new_jobs.description:
Wil je als senior fullstack developer een bijdrage leveren aan een veiliger Nederland? Voor het onderdeel Business Intelligence zoeken we een senior fullstack developer met DevOps\-skills. Je speelt een cruciale rol in het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde softwareoplossingen voor de politie.



**Specificaties vacature**
--------------------------


### **Locatie(s):**


Utrecht
### **Organisatieonderdeel:**


Politiedienstencentrum
### **Vakgebied(en):**


ICT
### **Niveau:**


HBO BACHELOR
**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


Jij gaat werken bij de productielijn Business Intelligence, in het cluster Zoeken en Vinden. Binnen dit cluster zijn verschillende DevOps\-teams actief voor de politie en diverse ketenpartners. Jouw team beheert en ontwikkelt applicaties en diensten om alle beschikbare informatie uit interne, nationale en internationale gegevensbronnen beschikbaar te maken voor ondersteuning van onze meldkamerdiensten. De applicaties waar jij aan werkt draaien op reguliere werkplekken én als mobiele app op de telefoons van onze collega's op straat. Met deze applicaties voorzien we de politie van de mogelijkheid om snel overzicht te genereren bij een incident. Jij gaat werken aan een 24/7 missie\-kritisch intelligencesysteem. De opdracht omvat architectuur, ontwerp, doorontwikkeling, onderhoud en beheer van dit intelligence response\-systeem.


Als senior fullstack developer ben je altijd bezig de software net dat beetje beter te maken en de CI/CD continu te optimaliseren. Een voordeel van werken bij de politie is dat er verschillende ondersteunende teams zijn die de clusters helpen bij het optimaliseren van kwalitatieve en veilige softwareontwikkeling, deployment en operations. Je werkt samen met een multidisciplinair team van DevOps engineers, IT\-experts en operationele professionals. Zo draag jij er met onze ICT\-oplossingen aan bij dat de politie tot de beste politiekorpsen ter wereld behoort.


**Waar ga je werken?**
----------------------


Het Productiehuis is een organisatieonderdeel binnen de Dienst IV van de politie waarin onze DevOps teams volgens de Agile\- en Scrummethode werken. In het Productiehuis zijn zeven Productielijnen ingericht, die zijn onderverdeeld volgens specifieke politiedomeinen. Jij gaat aan de slag in de productielijn Business Intelligence. Deze productielijn maakt producten die voorzien in de informatiebehoefte van de politie. Onze producten worden dagelijks gebruikt door alle politieagenten op straat, in de auto, de meldkamer en het Real Time Intelligence Center om snel informatie over een situatie op te vragen. Het is van groot belang dat deze informatie correct, snel, veilig en gemakkelijk te gebruiken is.


We werken hybride (volgens de scrummethodiek) waarvan minimaal 1 dag op kantoor in Utrecht. Verder is het goed om te weten dat er ook een beroep op je gedaan kan worden voor een piket dienst. Daarbij kan het voorkomen dat je buiten kantoortijd wordt opgeroepen. Het werk van de politie gaat immers 24/7 door.


Meer over DevOps engineering bij de politie


**Wie ben jij?**
----------------


Je bent een senior fullstack developer die zich net zo thuis voelt in de back\-end als in de front\-end, en die DevOps niet als bijzaak ziet maar als integraal onderdeel van het vak. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige traject: van ontwerp tot productie, inclusief de operationele kant. Een deel van onze gebruikers werkt met onze mobiele app, daarom is ervaring in Android\-ontwikkeling een pre.


Je bent analytisch, nieuwsgierig van aard en constant op zoek naar mogelijkheden om nieuwe technologieën te benutten in het voordeel van de klant. Je hanteert een vooruitstrevende aanpak om te komen tot resultaten met daarbij voortdurend aandacht voor kwaliteit en continuïteit. Je stelt jezelf regelmatig de vraag: hoe kan dit nóg beter, het is voor jou een uitdaging om hierover na te denken en je deelt graag je creatieve ideeën binnen en buiten het team. Bovendien ben je een echte teamspeler en kun je minder ervaren collega's begeleiden. Je past je gemakkelijk aan wanneer de situatie daarom vraagt, óók wanneer je onder druk komt te staan.


Verder heb je:


* hbo (bachelor) werk\- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van softwareontwikkeling;
* minimaal 6 jaar werkervaring als software developer waarvan 3 jaar als senior, met Java (17\+) en Spring Boot;
* ruime ervaring met werken in Agile\-, Continuous Delivery\- en DevOps\-omgevingen;
* aantoonbare werkervaring met:
	+ Front\-end: Angular 19\+, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 (SCSS), JavaScript, responsive design, unit en E2E testen, state management, component\-based development en het ontwikkelen van gebruiksvriendelijke, toegankelijke interfaces;
	+ Back\-end: Java 21, Kotlin, Spring Boot 4, REST/JSON, Reactive Programming, objectoriëntatie en datastructuren;
	+ DevOps \& Platform: OpenShift/Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitLab pipelines, Docker/Podman Compose, Linux, Bash, Python, Infrastructure as Code en configuratiebeheer;
	+ Data \& Messaging: Postgres, ElasticSearch, Kafka en S3;
	+ Tooling \& Security: Maven, Nexus, Sonar, Keycloak, Matomo, OAuth, OWASP, networking en security;
	+ TDD en testautomatisering.
* bij voorkeur heb je ervaring met Android\-ontwikkeling (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Gradle).

**Wat wij bieden**
------------------


De standplaats is Utrecht. Er is ruimte voor 1 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week.


Omdat goede mensen belangrijk zijn binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aanstelling in tijdelijke dienst voor een proeftijd van een jaar. Bij voldoende functioneren wordt de aanstelling na een jaar omgezet in een vaste aanstelling. Verder kun je het volgende van ons verwachten:


* een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 4\.422,\- en maximaal € 6\.490,\- (schaal 11 Bbp) op basis van een 36\-urige werkweek;
* een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) dat uit twee delen bestaat:

new_jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Wil jij eigenaar zijn van een platform dat er echt toe doet? Van cloudinfrastructuur en releases tot een vloot slimme kasten in het veld, en van security\-audits van veeleisende klanten tot de storing die niemand anders kan vinden? Dan is dit jouw kans.**

Wij zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die de dagelijkse werking van ons platform draagt: de Azure\-infrastructuur, het uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen, CI/CD en releases, security en compliance, kostenbeheersing en de sleutelkasten en lockers die bij onze klanten draaien. Je bent de specialist op wie het team en onze klanten kunnen bouwen. Je adviseert onze Chief Software Officer over de technische keuzes en begeleidt junior en medior DevOps engineers in hun ontwikkeling.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als Senior DevOps Engineer zorg jij dat wat het softwareteam bouwt betrouwbaar, veilig en herhaalbaar in productie komt en daar blijft draaien. Je ondersteunt de CSO bij strategische keuzes over architectuur en investeringen door te komen met onderbouwde voorstellen, die je uitvoert en bewaakt. Je werkt nauw samen met de Tech Lead en het softwareteam en bent het technische gezicht van Nauta Connect richting de IT\- en securityafdelingen van onze klanten.

* **Platform en netwerk:** je beheert en ontwikkelt onze cloud\- en on\-premise infrastructuur via Infrastructure as Code (Bicep/deployment stacks/Azure Verified Modules), firewalls, loadbalancers, Front Door, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Services, ExpressRoute en VPN, DNS en certificaten.
* **Uitrol nieuwe klanten:** je zet de infrastructuur voor nieuwe klanten en omgevingen geautomatiseerd en volgens de standaard neer (spoke, netwerk, database, toegang en configuratie), ontwikkelt die standaard door en faseert omgevingen gecontroleerd uit.
* **Releases en pipelines:** je onderhoudt en verbetert onze CI/CD\-pipelines in Azure DevOps (smoke\- en performancetests, quality gates, security scanning, geautomatiseerde databasemigraties) en voert de releases en hotfixes van onze productsuite uit, met minimale downtime via blue/green of canary deployments.
* **Security en compliance:** je werkt shift\-left: je signaleert en dicht kwetsbaarheden met tooling als SonarQube, GitLeaks, OWASP Dependency\-Check, Trivy en OWASP ZAP, stelt securityrapportages op, beantwoordt security\-vragenlijsten van klanten en ondersteunt onze ISO 27001\-audits.
* **Databases en observability:** je beheert onze SQL Server\- en PostgreSQL\-databases in productie (backups, herstel, migraties, performance) en richt monitoring in met Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics en Grafana.
* **Kosten:** je maakt de kosten van het platform per omgeving en per klant inzichtelijk, optimaliseert zonder verlies van beschikbaarheid of veiligheid en maakt de kostenimpact van elk voorstel expliciet.
* **Vloot en devices:** je bouwt en onderhoudt de Linux golden image voor onze kasten en lockers en beheert de vloot in het veld: provisioning, updates en het oplossen van problemen op de devices.
* **Incidenten en klantomgevingen:** je bent het eindstation voor storingen die support en het softwareteam niet kunnen oplossen, ook op het grensvlak van software en infrastructuur. Je bouwt testopstellingen die klantomgevingen nabootsen en helpt klanten ons product veilig in hun netwerk te landen.
* **Team en kennis:** je leidt de junior en medior DevOps engineers op, reviewt infrastructuur\- en securitywerk en zorgt dat kennis in het team wordt vastgelegd in plaats van in één hoofd.

**Wat motiveert jou?**

* **Eigenaarschap:** je bijdrage heeft een echte impact op ons platform.
* **Breedte:** cloud, netwerk, pipelines, security, databases, kosten, embedded devices en klantnetwerken; weinig DevOps\-rollen zijn zo veelzijdig.
* **Impact:** klanten als zorginstellingen en overheden vertrouwen dagelijks op wat jij draaiende houdt.
* **Groei:** bij bewezen diepgang volg jij het ontwikkelpad naar DevOps Architect.
* **Samenwerking:** korte lijnen met de CSO en de Tech Lead, en DevOps\-collega's die van jou willen leren.
* **Flexibiliteit:** hybride werken en werktijden die bij je passen.

**Dit bieden wij jou**

* Een compact, divers en gedreven team waarin jouw werk direct zichtbaar is
* Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van je ervaring, en fijne secundaire voorwaarden
* Tijd en budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en conferenties
* Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken
* Laptop en telefoon van de zaak en wat je nodig hebt om ook thuis prettig te werken
* 28 vakantiedagen
* Korting op je sportschoolabonnement, een vitaliteitsprogramma met allerlei (sportieve) activiteiten en gezellige teamuitjes.
* Een cultuur waarin experimenteren mag, fouten maken erbij hoort en successen samen gevierd worden

**Wat breng jij mee?**

* Een hbo\- of wo\-opleiding in IT of informatica, of gelijkwaardige kennis opgebouwd in de praktijk.
* Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in DevOps of platform engineering, met aantoonbare verantwoordelijkheid voor productieomgevingen.
* Diepgaande kennis van Microsoft Azure (onder meer App Services, Container Apps, Functions, Key Vault, Front Door, Application Gateway, SignalR, Managed Redis) en van Azure\-netwerken: landing zone, hub\-and\-spoke, VNet\-peering, NSG's, private endpoints, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute en VPN.
* Ruime ervaring met Infrastructure as Code met Bicep en/of Terraform, met containers (Docker, Container Apps, AKS) en met CI/CD in Azure DevOps Pipelines.
* Ervaring met het geautomatiseerd uitrollen van nieuwe klantomgevingen.
* Ervaring met high\-availability\-ontwerpen en minimal\-downtime\-releases (blue/green, canary) en met incidentonderzoek op basis van logs, traces en databases.
* Ervaring met DevSecOps\-tooling, CVE\-afhandeling en securityrapportages binnen ISO 27001, de OWASP Top 10 en de NCSC\-richtlijnen.
* Ervaring met SQL Server en PostgreSQL in productie, met monitoring en observability en met Linux inclusief golden images.
* Scripting in Bash en PowerShell, en voldoende leesvaardigheid in .NET/C\# om applicatiecode op infrastructuur\- en securityaspecten te reviewen.
* Het vermogen om complexe technische zaken helder uit te leggen aan klanten en collega's, in het Nederlands en Engels.

**Een pré:** ervaring met ARM en Ansible, MariaDB en MySQL, fleetmanagement van embedded devices, Python en/of C\#, andere cloudplatformen, of certificeringen op het gebied van Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform of security.

**Wie zijn wij?**

Nauta Connect ontwikkelt slimme oplossingen voor de uitgifte en het beheer van sleutels en bedrijfsmiddelen: elektronische sleutelkasten en lockers, naadloos geïntegreerd met onze eigen Connect\-software. Die software is het kloppende hart van onze oplossingen en wordt volledig in huis ontwikkeld. Onze klanten zijn onder meer zorginstellingen, gemeentes, onderwijsinstellingen en organisaties met hoge eisen aan veiligheid en beschikbaarheid.

Ons softwareteam is compact, hecht en denkt actief mee. We gaan graag de uitdaging aan om complexe problemen binnen organisaties op te lossen, waarbij onze hardware en slimme software samen het verschil maken. Korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en de ruimte om iets écht te bouwen.

Nauta Connect is onderdeel van de Nauta Group, een (h)echt familiebedrijf met het hoofdkantoor in Barneveld. Hoe gaat het met je? En heb je nog leuke plannen voor de komende dagen? Het zijn vragen die je vaak hoort in onze wandelgangen. We houden van persoonlijk contact met elkaar en met onze klanten, en werken iedere dag met een enthousiast team van zo'n 130 medewerkers aan het succes van ons bedrijf.

**Vragen of solliciteren?**

Ben je enthousiast geworden over deze vacature en is dit de volgende uitdaging in jouw loopbaan. Wacht dan niet en solliciteer direct! Voor meer informatie over de Nauta Group kun je kijken op www.nautagroup.com/werkenbij.

Salaris: €6\.000,00 \- €7\.500,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Auto van de zaak
* Bedrijfsfitness
* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Fietsplan
* Flexibele werkuren
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Telefoon van de zaak
* Werk vanuit huis
* Winstdeling

Screeningsvragen:

* Woon je in Nederland?
* Heb je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met Azure, Azure DevOps, Docker, Linux, Bicep?

Opleiding:

* HBO (Vereist)

Taal:

* Nederlands op professioneel niveau (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 3771 Barneveld
